review.reason: The mapped layout, greens, hazards, walking connectors, and striped fairways are largely represented well. Added trees clutter Hole 2’s tee-to-green corridor and make its route difficult to read.

issues.detail: Trees crowd the corridor from the Hole 2 tee toward its landing area and green, especially through the central area between them.
issues.consequence: The overview makes the Hole 2 route appear obstructed and obscures its intended line of play.
